$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for portfolio allocation buckets, position sizing, Stage 2 momentum & No-FOMO entry rules, and citation standards. Skills must reference this file and must not restate numbers that differ from it.

LEAPS_OPTIONS.note: LEAPS only; short-dated options are outside this cap

position_sizing.let_winners_run_rule: Never mechanically trim a Stage 2 winner with intact fundamentals and rising/stable estimates solely because RSI > 70 or weight crossed 15%; allow appreciated weight up to runaway_winner_cap_pct (22%) while trailing the stop to the rising 21-day EMA or 50-day SMA.

risk_unit_sizing.note: Size new entries by NAV risk-to-stop (bps of portfolio lost if stop is hit) capped by the tier notional range. Wider stops automatically receive smaller initial notional weights.

stage2_momentum.principle: Focus on leading momentum sectors and catch high-conviction businesses in early Stan Weinstein Stage 2 advances or tight base/pullback setups — never chase extended FOMO spikes, and never rely on synthetic LLM formula math.

weinstein_stages.STAGE_2: Price above rising 30-week SMA (SMA150 / SMA200) and rising 50-day SMA, with positive sector breadth.
weinstein_stages.STAGE_2_PULLBACK: Primary Stage 2 uptrend intact (price > 30W SMA & 200D SMA), pulling back constructively toward the 10-week EMA / 20D-50D SMA support zone on contracting volume.
weinstein_stages.STAGE_1_BASE: Constructive multi-week horizontal base or turnaround accumulation near a flattening 30W / 200D SMA with relative strength inflecting up.
weinstein_stages.STAGE_3_DISTRIBUTION: Chopping laterally or breaking below a flattening 50D SMA after an extended advance while still above the 200D SMA.
weinstein_stages.STAGE_4_BREAKDOWN: Price below a falling 30-week SMA and falling 50-day SMA. Automatic avoid/reject for new buys and prune candidate for the watchlist.

no_fomo_entry_rules.IMMEDIATE_BUY: Stock is in Early Stage 2 (1-8 weeks in Stage 2 or fresh base breakout / constructive pullback), within 10% of its 10W EMA / 50D SMA, RSI(14) <= 73, and valuation + business execution support immediate deployment at CMP.
no_fomo_entry_rules.WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT: Business quality and Stage 2 trend are strong, but price is extended (>10% above 10W EMA, >12% above 50D SMA, or RSI > 73) OR valuation requires a margin-of-safety pullback. Place on Shortlist with a concrete limit-order support zone (20D EMA / 10W EMA / 50D SMA).
no_fomo_entry_rules.REJECTED: Broken Stage 4 downtrend, structural business/governance failure, or severe valuation disconnect with deteriorating fundamentals. Prune from active watchlist to archive.

watchlist_pruning.rule: Keep the active watchlist focused. Automatically move any active watchlist stock in a confirmed Stage 4 breakdown or marked REJECTED/AVOID into watchlist.archive via scripts/stock_snapshot.py --prune-watchlist.

stop_placement.CORE_ALPHA: Below nearest structural support (50-day SMA, 10-week EMA, or recent consolidation swing low minus 1.0 x ATR14).
stop_placement.TACTICAL_MOMENTUM: Below nearest tactical support (20-day EMA / 50-day SMA or breakout pivot low minus 0.5 x ATR14).
stop_placement.undercut_and_reclaim_rule: Evaluate stops on the session close. If a holding briefly undercuts support intra-week and reclaims its 50-day SMA / 10-week EMA on positive volume, retain the holding and anchor the stop below the shakeout low.
